bloques: BABELTRANS is a global provider of linguistic services and specializes mainly in translation and interpreting.
Since 1999 we have offered language solutions and our professional experience has positioned us in a privilliged market position that allows us to satisfy our clients' needs.

At BABELTRANS we show great awareness of language. Therefore, all our projects are always carried out under strict quality control procedures and the final revision is done by an independent translator.
All our collaborators are experts in their fields who only translate into their mother tongue, thereby assuring the high quality that we offer.
Rest assured that all the information we receive will be treated as highly confidential. To this end, our professionals are hired and trained according to our Code of Ethics and Business Conduct.
We offer a wide range of languages in any field of expertise.
Nuestra estrategia está basada en las relaciones sostenibles con nuestros clientes y en la mejora continua de nuestros procesos
"Language is not instinctive; it is due to a cultural process"
We pride ourselves on having the best team of translators, experts in their fields, whether for interpretation or translation.
These professionals' skills not only involve mastery of vocabulary in their given field, but they also detect syntactic structures that provide natural language in a written and spoken context.
Our translators create a matching relationship between the source text and the target text so that both convey the same message.
Translation is one of the arts that requires most dedication and talent, as the simplest text could be plagued with ambiguities.
Depending on the type of text, at BABELTRANS we select the most ideal translation avoiding the excessively literal that all too often shows a lack of language awareness.
Commercial: web pages, offers, orders, brochures.
Technical: - scientific: engineering, automotion, technical manuals, assembly instructions, scientific.
Sworn: deeds, (birth) certifiates, letters of authorization, degrees.
All translations include a final revision by an independent translator.
Proofreading of original documents upon the client's request.
Interpreting is a complex activity that requires considerable effort and experience in order to obtain the best results.

BABELTRANS has the finest team of translators at its disposal. They are able to us equivalents that are as close and natural as possible to the original language, not only when it comes to meaning but also in terms of style.
We offer the quality of interpreting services that can make your event a succes.
Consecutive: press conferences, corporate meetings, negotiations, commercial mediation.
Teleconference and videoconference: conference calls with partners, suppliers.
Sworn interpretation: notary's office, courts, trials.

Since 1999, BABELTRANS has offered translation and interpreting services following a unique methodology as well as a continuous improvement process.
Each job is considered an exclusive project to which we devote all the necessary time and means.
We guarantee a coherent translation of all documents, taking great care with common definitions, phrases and terminology.
Each project will be studied before assigning it to a professional according to the specific need of each client.
All projects will be checked by an independent professional.
Format and layout according to the original document or as requested by the client.
Translation memories that allow for linguistic patterns and common terminology.
Glossaries for each specific field of expertise.
